note: Calendar years and dates (r. 1995, roku 1993); fits.
Uses are have/possess (nemám komentář, mít trpělivost), not market; ÚFAL def says vlastnit, so the offset-to-ILI step (CILI or old offset) is the likely error.
Size and magnitude (velké úpravy, větší počet, velký zájem); def covers magnitude.
Price of goods/services; monetary value fits.
Statutes (návrh zákona, ústavní zákon); fits legal document though ÚFAL synset is about právo.
All uses are Czech currency, not the English 5-shilling coin; old Czech WN linked koruna to the English crown coin.
Business company in all samples (incl. s. r. o.).
Want/want to; some uses lean to intend (chce reinvestovat) but desire is fine.
Uses are high in degree/amount (nejvyšší teplota, vyšší cena, nejvyšší kvalita), not high-pitched; ÚFAL redefined the high-pitched synset as non-height highness.
v tomto případě = in this case; special set of circumstances fits.
Political party in all four samples.
Entire/whole (celý svět, celá firma); whole sibling equally good.
Indefinite period (v současné době, v poslední době).
Days as time units/dates; one idiom (na pořadu dne).
Uses are banks as financial institutions, not clearing house; no listed wncze sense fits (depository financial institution missing for banka); likely mapping/linking slip to a neighbouring concept.
All samples are jít o = be about/concern, not adopt/follow; no listed sense fits; wncze synset words (jít, následovat, hájit) already odd, so old linking.
Begin an action; one intransitive use (začalo vysílání) fits begin 02531337.
All samples are reporting verb uvedl = said/stated, not adduce/cite; no listed sense fits (state/say missing); ÚFAL def (říci, sdělit) disagrees with English concept.
Parts of property, shares, a year, a sum; English restricts to artifacts, generic part fits better.
Mostly tel./FAX in addresses (really fax number); machine is a defensible metonymy.
3 of 4 samples are durations (za měsíc, na tři měsíce), better as the ~30-day time unit; calendar month defensible.
Czech město covers town and city; English town (smaller than city) is narrow; urban-area city sense not listed.
Mostly plural volby = elections (vote is near); one sample is volba biskupů = election as act of selecting; evidence thin.
Samples mix procedure (systém hodnocení), scheme and technical system; only one fits the artifact sense; ÚFAL def broadened to uspořádání objektů.
Contracts in 3/4 sentences; one is an EU enlargement treaty (06357547).
All uses are 'relating to the economy'.
Young people; some uses are closer to 'offspring' (09285271), but the tag is fine.
The state as governing body (care, veto, subsidies), matching the ÚFAL definition.
Continent; some uses mean Europe as a political union, which is still defensible.
Uses are the political entity (member state, successor states, states that fought), not the territory.
Uses mean spot or location (crime scene, destination, on site; one is 'seats'), not vicinity. The ÚFAL def describes 'place', and the Czech synset oddly groups místo with okolí/sousedství.
Boards or councils (state council, broadcasting council); council 07809840 also defensible.

Uses mean entitlement (TV rights, right to start, asylum right). The ÚFAL def 'nárok, oprávnění' matches that, not 'rightfulness'; PDT words (právo, nárok) vs wncze (zákonnost, legitimnost) suggest a mapping or relink error.
Coalition talks fit, but other uses are meetings or sessions (disciplinary hearing, parliamentary session); no meeting sense is listed.
Apartment. The PDT synset oddly includes komnata, but the uses fit.
Social insurance, housing and spending (welfare sense) fit 'relating to society' loosely.
Uses are trade in general (trade volume, diamond trade, trade conditions), not one deal. Single-word synset with no def, so likely the old CzWN linking.
Sports coaches; 'trainer' is defensible (no coach sense listed).
Calendar weeks (last week, week of the betting round).
2/4 are single sales (a stake, Breda); 2/4 are general selling ('výroba a prodej'). Fine-grained.
Temporal end (end of the year or decade).
Work; some uses lean towards 'be employed' (02338081).

Uses are obtain or gain (money, information, funds, trust), never recruit. wncze words are the recruit set (přijmout, najmout, rekrutovat), while the PDT synset holds only získat, which points to the mapping or relink.
Uses are shares (price, dividend per share, issue), not the paper certificate.
Uses mean home-country or home-side (domestic films, funds, soloists, peloton), not 'internal affairs'; no better sense is listed.
Growth or increase (exports, prices); 'expansion' is defensible.
